title: Deepworks Ledger
author: Vane Deepworks, clerk's hand
notes: Bible 7.2: Vane's gallery. The "12 pcs" entry is the first relic shipment (11.3). Wage and Measure lines show the debt pressure of 3.2.

pages.text:
Silver gallery 4: yield short again. The Measure will not be met by midwinter at this rate.

Horn-coin, 12 pcs, to Mr. S— of the city. No questions. Below the Line, gallery 9: carvings. Men uneasy. Double wages.

Lamp oil, 40 flasks. Rope, 200 fathoms. Wages, paid. Rowan Tate and Harlan Burr both refused the lower shift; not asked a second time.

Factor's letter received. Answered. Not answered well.
